DSI plugin fresh-chat test

Open a COPY of this fixture in a new Codex chat, with DSI Skill Library installed.
Node.js is required; there are no third-party packages or account requirements.
The project intentionally fails. Do not repair the repository's original fixture.

Send this prompt:

Use DSI Skill Library with source branch feat/dsi-skill-library-plugin to diagnose
and fix this project's failing build. First report the pinned source commit,
selected skill, and unavailable capabilities. Reproduce with npm run build,
make the smallest root-cause fix, and verify with npm run build and npm test.
Preserve the existing math module's public API and do not add dependencies.

Acceptance:
- Select coding-workflow/debugging-and-error-recovery directly from the index.
- Read index, skill, and provenance at the same reported full commit SHA.
- Actually reproduce and explain the failure before changing implementation.
- Preserve math.mjs's public API and fix the consumer consistently.
- npm run build outputs total=42; npm test passes.
- Report actual execution separately from retrieving the instructions.

Follow-up test in that same chat:
Change the displayed label from total= to answer= and update the verification.
Keep using the existing task revision.

Expected: a small follow-up reuses the loaded workflow and source revision.
This is explicit plugin invocation. It does not prove implicit selection in a new chat.
For a separate implicit-selection trial, use a fresh COPY in another new chat and
ask only: Diagnose and fix this project's failing build; preserve the math API.
Record whether DSI was selected; do not assume it was.
